$comment: TASK-1005 — the model-residency agent contract. PINNED by the orchestrator before the lanes branched. PRODUCERS: the residency agent API in packages/py-runtime-models (hope_runtime_models), mounted by apps/stt and apps/nlp (lane L-AGENT) — snake_case JSON under `python`; the gateway-side LM Studio adapter (lane L-LMS) — which emits the camelCase `gateway` ResidencyReport shape directly from LM Studio REST v1. CONSUMER: the gateway ModelResidencyController (lane L-CTRL, wave 2), which maps every `python` report to the same camelCase `gateway` shape, and the console screen (lane L-UI). Transport for the Python agents: `X-Service-Token` + `X-Tenant-Id: tenantless:control-plane` (TENANTLESS.CONTROL_PLANE in packages/applications/src/common/internal-service-headers.ts). Routes: GET /internal/residency · POST /internal/residency/load · POST /internal/residency/unload · PUT /internal/residency/models/{model_ref}/policy. Lanes MAY add per-service `load_spec` examples under `loadSpecExamples`; they may NOT rename, retype or remove a pinned key. `bytes` is MEASURED (device free-memory delta around the load, loads serialised per device) or null — never a catalogue estimate; `bytes_source` says which. `in_flight` is the cache pin refcount (requests/sessions currently holding the model). `pinned` is true when ANY holder pins it; `admin_pinned` only when the operator/controller pinned it (survives idle TTL, never LRU/pressure-evicted). An unload with `in_flight > 0` and no `force` answers 409 IN_FLIGHT.

error.message: arcaai-whisper-ml-en-ggml is serving 1 request(s); pass force=true to unload anyway

gateway.$lmStudioNotes: LM Studio reports no per-model bytes, in-flight count or timestamps (REST v1, verified 2026-09-24): those fields are null and the controller fills bytes from the DCGM per-device delta it measured around its own serialised load. `device` is `multi` because the daemon splits a model across both cards itself. `instanceId` and `loadConfig` are LM Studio-only extras (optional on every other service).
